svg.title: A nurse wants to convey attentiveness and openness while talking with an anxious client. Which nonverbal behaviors should the nurse use? (Select all that apply.)
svg.desc: Sitting at eye level, an open posture, culturally appropriate eye contact, and unhurried pacing tell the client there is time and interest. Standing in the doorway or facing a screen signals that the nurse is leaving or divided, and clients read that message more strongly than anything the nurse says.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Nonverbal Communication
Read the situation
A nurse wants to convey attentiveness and
openness while talking with an anxious
client. Which nonverbal behaviors should
the nurse use? (Select all that apply.)
What fits here
Sit down at the client's eye level · Keep
arms and legs uncrossed · Maintain eye
contact as appropriate for the client's
culture · Use a relaxed posture and an
unhurried pace
Why it fits
Sitting at eye level, an open posture,
culturally appropriate eye contact, and
unhurried pacing tell the client there is
time and interest. Standing in the doorway
or facing a screen signals that the nurse
is leaving or divided, and clients read
that message more strongly than anything
the nurse says.
